summary:
Implemented customer self-cancellation feature and admin cancellation monitoring & filtering:
1. Customers can cancel their orders directly from the Success/Confirmation View and from the "অর্ডার চেক করুন" Order Tracking portal.
2. Multiple standard reasons + custom reason selection before confirming cancellation.
3. Synchronized cancellation status across Firestore, Supabase, Local Storage, and cPanel.
4. Admin Dashboard features dedicated cancelled sub-filter: All Cancelled, Customer Cancelled, and Admin Cancelled.
5. Highlighted badges and cancellation reasons with timestamps in admin order cards and order detail inspection modal, along with a 1-click 'Restore to Pending' button.
